about: Call types derived by code from structured call-map inputs, never by a model (AUT-341 decision brief, decision 1; AUT-629). The CTO proposes the list, the rule readings and the thresholds; the owner confirms them at the AC-SVAL Gate 2 review together with the signal list. Until then every threshold below is a proposed test setting, not approved business semantics. Report Lab v8 reuses this list. It changes only through a new file version. The twins are call_type.py and apps/sales-xray-web/app/call-type.ts.

not_sales.label: Not a sales call
not_sales.rule: call_purpose is support, onboarding, internal or personal. Never inferred from phases; a missing or unclear purpose gives unclear.

objection_negotiation.label: Objection or negotiation
objection_negotiation.rule: Objection time (objection phases joined with objection spans, overlaps counted once) is more than the time of every other stage.

prospect_story.label: Prospect story (mostly listening)
prospect_story.rule: Prospect talk share is more than prospect_share_over; exactly that value does not match.

screening.label: Screening call
screening.rule: Call is at most short_call_ms, at least one qualification item is confirmed, there is no pitch, and the outcome advances or stops (follow_up, disqualified or lost).

first_meeting.label: First meeting (questions only)
first_meeting.rule: Discovery is present, with no pitch and no close.

pitch_demo.label: Pitch or demo
pitch_demo.rule: Pitch time is more than pitch_share_over of the call (exactly half does not match) and discovery is at most little_questions_ms.

follow_up_closing.label: Follow-up or closing call
follow_up_closing.rule: Discovery is at most little_questions_ms and a close phase or a measured price moment is present.

full_sales.label: Full sales call
full_sales.rule: Discovery, pitch and close are all present.
